kids-points-v2 2.0.0 is a major rewrite with improved reliability and more features.

- Migrated storage from text files to SQLite for better stability and data integrity.
- Added LLM-powered semantic analysis for natural language input, adaptable to various family expressions.
- Introduced CLI interface (cli.py) for easy integration with agents, scripts, or external tools.
- Removed built-in ASR; now relies on Feishu’s own speech-to-text function.
- Full support for both group and private chats in Feishu.
- Implemented automatic duplicate detection using messageId to prevent repeated entries.
